To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Customer relationship management (CRM), as an organizational strategy, is a powerful and useful tool for the organizations in order to increase innovation capabilities.
customer relationship management and innovation are positively related and knowledge management plays a mediating role in this relationship.
Customer Relationship Management (CRMs) has a positive effect on innovation capabilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of customer relationship management on innovation capabilities with knowledge management mediator variable.
the effects of customer relationship management on innovation capabilities with knowledge management as mediator variable.

the role of customer relationship management on innovation capabilities and knowledge management as a mediator variable in Mahram Company and the results of this research are as following: 1) all aspects of customer relation management have a positive effect on innovation capabilities in Mahram Company; 2) all aspects of knowledge management have a positive and significant effect on innovation capabilities; 3) knowledge management is a mediator variable in the relationship between customer relation management and innovation capabilities.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the customer relationship management and its substructures and knowledge management have a meaningful and positive role in the innovation capabilities of Mahram Company and also knowledge management has a mediating effect on the customer relationship management substructures and innovation capabilities of the organization.

customer relationship management is one of the important and effective factors for organizational innovation capabilities that through using of this tool, organizational managers would be aware of customer ideas and opinions about products, services and processes and consequently they could improve their organizational performance and competitiveness.

with regard to the importance of innovation capabilities and competitive advantage, the role of knowledge and information management in this field is undeniable and it could be concluded that with using of customer relationship management tools and knowledge management, innovation capabilities of the company could be improved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have been able to show the effects of CRM and KM on innovation capabilities and the mediating role of KM in the relationship between CRM and innovation capabilities in Mahram company.
this study has provided a better insight to the relationship between customer relationship management (CRMs), knowledge management (KMs) and innovation capabilities (ICs).
this research is an important step towards the understanding of the role of customer relationship management in organizational innovation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most important factor that affects innovation capabilities in Mahram Company is knowledge management that has an important role in the field of customer relationship management.

the customer relationship management and its knowledge management is a very powerful source for the companies to achieve innovation capabilities in order to improve their performance and to gain competitive advantage over competitors.
, while it is important to understand how to manage customer relationships, it is also important to understand how customer relationships are managed.
